whyThisMatch.title.issue: The term 'członek' (member) is correct but 'Dlaczego ten członek?' sounds a bit blunt/formal. 'Osoba' (person) is more common and friendly in this context for an app.

whyThisMatch.ethicsNote.issue: The phrase 'czyja podróż świeci teraz' is a literal translation of 'whose journey shines right now' but is not idiomatic in Polish. A journey doesn't 'shine' in this context; it can be inspiring or remarkable.
whyThisMatch.ethicsNote.suggested: Vitana nie ocenia członków na podstawie wyglądu ani majątku — ale oto ktoś, czyja podróż jest teraz inspirująca.

whyThisMatch.tierLabel.4.issue: 'Przekierowanie sprawiedliwości' (Redirection of fairness) is a very literal translation that sounds abstract and unnatural as a feature name. 'Sprawiedliwe przekierowanie' (Fair rerouting) is more idiomatic and sounds like a feature.
